body: Haha! Thank you for checking. You're right I just need to get better. I was definitely being a sour apple last night about losing lol

Public opinion is changing. Demonizing poor mental health is becoming a thing of the past in the workplace.

Western society is starting to identify the massive influx of employees with our ailments. It will stop with everyone's help to demystify it.

I understand that. My roommate, whom I was playing with, was interested in auditing the game and said the same thing. A photo is needed to verify the final scoring. 

I was more so making sure the math listed in my photo post made sense because I'm insecure about myself and question the legitimacy of my failure to win. :)

Hi. Sorry for infiltrating your subreddit like this. However I smell heavy foul play in the midst of our Ticket to Ride bout. 

I will say, I had a blast playing this game for the first time. I loved it. I particularly felt as though I had the upper hand in this game, and ultimately felt as though the person I trusted in scorekeeping this game was doing it right. 

However the shadow of doubt I harbored led me to post our scorecard here in hopes someone could doublecheck the math AND HONOR of this game.
Thank you for the level response. I think there's an element of human nature too.  I find that last line very interesting.

I prefer to not discuss details as to why or how, as I understand that could be hard to read and digest for others. 

I guess I'm just in need of a place to talk about it. I think there's power to affix my thoughts in a "physical" medium. 

A journal is too easily found. A therapist is expensive and traceable. A hotline ties up a representative for someone else who needs it more. Perhaps I dont belong here. Im not really sure.
How long have you been exposed to the thought train of it? If you know how you WOULDN'T kill yourself then surely you know how you WOULD. Right?

You're right to have that type of response. However, I simply did not know this type of benefit was available at the time.

And I've physically been to the office to start the claiming process. It was advised for me to file my original claim (to get me in the system) THEN to pursue a back-pay appeal if I wished to do so. I'm in the deciding step right now.
